description: Results first measured with the ACC target speed at 0.1 m/s per code, recomputed with the current 0.125 m/s per code (SCR-463) from the same research-workspace tables and selections; old values reproduced at 0.1 first as a check. Docs cite the 'new' values.

claims.claim: When object-list vRel and ACC closing speed differ by > 3 m/s, vision sides with the ACC target 86-90% (discovery 90%, n=715; confirmation 86%, n=421, route-bootstrap 79-99%)
claims.inputs: SCR-115: data/derived/ars510_signal_atlas/seg/* (split.json discovery 256 / confirmation 143 segments), exploration/acc_target.py per_seg + confirm.py C1/C1b logic; old values reproduced exactly (0.8965 n715; 0.8622 n421 CI 0.791-0.985)
claims.method: Re-ran acc_target.per_seg on the atlas caches, re-decoded 0x235 code exactly (code = acc_vrel/0.1, x0.125); same association (cost<1, margin>1, age>=60, vision prob>0.8, distance within max(25%,5 m)), same |native-ACC|>3 gate, same route bootstrap (seed 7, 2000). Discovery CI is new (original reported none). Selection changes with the unit (n 715->738, 421->484).

claims.claim: ACC closer to the native range slope in 76% of 51 tail episodes; median error 1.2 vs 3.3 m/s
claims.inputs: SCR-411: data/derived/ars510_acc_kinematic_filter_20261003/tails.py on data/derived/ars510_acc_continuous_teacher_20261002/dataset.parquet (payload235 column); old reproduced exactly
claims.method: tails.py verbatim with oem_vrel decoded from raw payload235 (BE bits 29-39 - 1024) x 0.125 (asserted code x 0.1 == stored oem_vrel). Episodes = |ACC-native|>2 for >=0.5 s, so the episode set changes (51 -> 62).

claims.claim: Optical-reference error scale of ACC target 0.31 / 0.54 m/s at 10-40 / 40-70 m vs 0.55 / 1.07 for the object list; ACC present in 38% of 40-130 m windows and 11% beyond 80 m
claims.inputs: VID-6 addendum 2: data/derived/ars510_wheel_cell_mechanism_20261002/acc_independence.py (teacher dataset.parquet, ars510_video_looming_20261002/steps.parquet, ars510_native_quality_fields/slots_*.parquet, ars510_drift_mechanism/samples_{discovery,confirmation}.parquet); coverage: VID-7 data/derived/ars510_chain_interface_20261002 (decoder copy source/ars510/interface.py _acc_target_match); public summary video_truth.json acc_target_velocity
claims.method: acc_independence.py verbatim with O = stored oem_vrel x 1.25; three-cornered hat (N,O,L) as original. Old reproduced exactly. At 0.125 the 10-40 m ACC hat variance is ~1e-4 (sigma ~0.01): the ACC is no longer resolvable from zero there, var(ACC-loom) halves 0.40 -> 0.19; 40-70 m unchanged at 0.54. The vision-model shared-error signal disappears (var(O-M) ratio 0.77/0.63 -> 1.28/0.95). Coverage is unit-invariant: the fusion gate is position/age/presence only (cost<1, margin>1, age>=60), so 38% / 11% stand without recomputation.

claims.claim: 84-88% of excursions are false closings (SCR-117 clean-label D4: false_closing_share 0.84 discovery / 0.875 confirmation)
claims.inputs: SCR-117: atlas caches + exploration/clean_labels.py per_seg/labels (no age filter); data/derived/ars510_signal_atlas/confirmation_round2.json; D4 producer not saved
claims.method: Clean labels verbatim (|nat-ACC|>3 & |nat-vis|>3 & |ACC-vis|<1.5; normal |nat-ACC|<0.7 & |nat-vis|<1). D4 definition reconstructed and verified to reproduce the saved values exactly at 0.1 (344/37,790 and 230/16,228 records; 79 / 32 episodes; 0.835 / 0.875; confirmation ratio 21.73x, rates 0.01026 / 0.22287): episodes = (seg, slot) runs split at > 0.5 s gaps; false closing = episode median(native-ACC) < 0; rate = glitch/normal records by native range. Discovery ratio reproduces as 30.1x (protocol quoted 31x). Labels change with the unit.

claims.claim: SCR-417 excursion sigma scale: RMS(native - ACC) 0.04-0.05 m/s per 240|7 count; Gaussian sigma=0.045*code predicts far excursion incidence (5.1% obs vs 6.4% pred; fresh 6.9% vs 5.5%); state model predicts ~41-47% of error variance on 40 fresh segments; R2 0.11 for 84|10; mean offset native-ACC -0.3 m/s (-0.1 below 20 m, -0.6 at 80-110 m)
claims.inputs: SCR-417: data/derived/ars510_excursion_cause_20261003/{m30_prep_tables.py, m25_bias_scale_decode_check.py, m26_full_signal_scan.py, m34_gbm_fresh_validation.py}, code/reproduce/excursion_sigma_calibration.py; caches rebuilt from data/derived/ars510_signal_atlas/seg (700 segs) and ars510_unknown_signal_census_20261003/fresh_tables (114 segs) with a lean copy of build_unknown_signal_cache.py (aux limited to 0x235/0x237)
claims.method: m30 prep with vacc = (BE29|11-1024) x unit (only change), then the calibration, m25 and m26 (84|10 only) code verbatim and m34 GBM unchanged. K=0.045 and mu=-0.3 kept fixed. Old values reproduced exactly (227,388 / 13,257 rows; 5.15/6.45%, 6.91/5.52%; 84|10 R2 0.11373) except the GBM fresh R2 (0.424/0.470 here vs reported 0.408/0.465; small fit-level difference). Note the predicted incidence does not depend on the ACC unit.

claims.claim: 0x235 byte-2 relative acceleration vs radard aLeadK: less wobble (0.12 vs 0.152); corr .64 vs .56, RMS .68 vs .80, lag .48 vs .84 s against the native-speed reference
claims.method: accel_byte.py verbatim with acc_v re-decoded from h235 at 0.125 (asserted x0.1 matches stored) and byte 2 (code-100) x 0.125; old json reproduced byte-for-byte. Wobble = std of 17-record detrended signal (ego-accel term unchanged, so not exactly x1.25). The b2 lag vs the native reference is weakly identified (corr curve flat 0.636-0.643 over 0-0.6 s at both units), so 0.48 s -> 0.0 s is not a meaningful timing change.

claims.claim: Object-list speed vs ACC speed slope at 40-80 m 0.99 / 1.02 (SCR-117 D5)
claims.inputs: SCR-117: atlas caches + clean_labels.py per_seg; confirmation_round2.json D5; research captures (D5 definition)
claims.method: Reconstructed D5 = np.polyfit(v_ground*0.149/0.15, acc_vrel + v_ego, 1) slope on clean-normal records with |native vRel|>1 per 20 m band; reproduces 0.9893/1.0218 (n 711/125) and 0.9914/1.0007 exactly at 0.1. Caveat: over-ground slope is dominated by ego speed and clean-normal records are pre-selected for |native-ACC|<0.7, so this test is nearly insensitive to the ACC unit by construction.

claims.claim: 0x680 speed vs ACC speed on the same vehicle; 0x680 within 1 m/s of the ACC target during object-list excursions
claims.inputs: research workspace 0x680 object-stream study (frames table), same selection
claims.method: ACC speed rescaled to 0.125 m/s per code
